# pbs_user (Resource)

Manages a Proxmox Backup Server user (`/access/users`).

Users of the `pbs` realm can be given a password; users of other realms (e.g. `pam`, LDAP, OpenID)
authenticate against their realm and only need to exist in PBS for permissions and API tokens.

**Note:** Deleting a user also deletes its API tokens and their ACL entries, but PBS does **not** remove ACL
entries granted to the user itself. Manage those with `pbs_acl` resources that reference this user, so
Terraform removes them together with it.

**Note:** The password is write-only: PBS never returns it, so it cannot be imported and changes made outside
Terraform are not detected. Changing the password in place requires the provider to authenticate with
username/password; PBS rejects password changes made with an API token.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# User of the built-in pbs realm with a password
resource "pbs_user" "backup_operator" {
  userid    = "backup-operator@pbs"
  password  = var.backup_operator_password
  firstname = "Backup"
  lastname  = "Operator"
  email     = "backup-operator@example.com"
  comment   = "Managed by Terraform"
}

# Temporarily disabled user that expires on 2030-01-01
resource "pbs_user" "contractor" {
  userid  = "contractor@pbs"
  enable  = false
  expire  = 1893456000
  comment = "External contractor"
}

# PBS does not remove a user's own ACL entries when the user is deleted;
# manage them with pbs_acl so Terraform removes them together with the user.
resource "pbs_acl" "backup_operator" {
  path    = "/datastore/backups"
  auth_id = pbs_user.backup_operator.userid
  role    = "DatastoreBackup"
}

variable "backup_operator_password" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `userid` (String) User ID in the form `name@realm`, e.g. `alice@pbs`. The realm must exist. Changing it replaces the user (and deletes its API tokens).

### Optional

- `comment` (String) Comment (single line, at most 128 characters).
- `email` (String) E-mail address (2-64 characters).
- `enable` (Boolean) Whether the user is enabled. Defaults to `true`.
- `expire` (Number) Account expiration as Unix epoch seconds; `0` means the account never expires. Defaults to `0`.
- `firstname` (String) First name (2-64 characters).
- `lastname` (String) Last name (2-64 characters).
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Password (8-64 characters). Only allowed for users of the `pbs` realm; other realms (e.g. `pam`, LDAP, OpenID) manage passwords themselves, and setting it on a `pam` user would change the Linux system password. Write-only on the PBS side: stored in state, never read back and not importable. Changing it updates the password in place (requires username/password authentication of the provider). Removing it from the configuration leaves the current password on the server unchanged.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Users are imported by their userid (name@realm).
# The password is not imported; PBS never returns it.
terraform import pbs_user.backup_operator backup-operator@pbs
```
